description: This file is a Yocto build recipe fragment (.inc) for the Xen hypervisor. It defines build instructions, file distributions, configuration steps, and deployment procedures specific to Xen within a Yocto project environment.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Configures the Xen build by handling configuration fragments and merging them if present.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Compiles the Xen hypervisor using make, passing necessary variables.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the compiled Xen hypervisor into the destination directory.

methods.name: do_deploy
methods.description: Deploys the Xen hypervisor files into the deployment directory, conditional on their existence.
